notes: Z-3 reports aggregate benefit period and employer's notes on return from childcare leave. Potential mismatch between start and birth dates demands review; do not infer continuous granted parental period.

findings: Employer Z-3 p3 gives 2024-05-22 to 2025-06-20 as aggregate reported benefit interval.
Civil birth certificate p11 says 2024-05-23, while employer leave request p25 states 2024-05-22: dates inconsistent and require source reconciliation.
Employer consent on p25 is evidence of employment leave, not of ZUS payment. No amount confirmed.
full_source_review.legal_outcome_vs_app_test: source evidence only; no app calculation assertion run

full_source_audit.documentary_findings: Employer Z-3 p3 starts reported benefits on 2024-05-22, but child birth certificate p11 says 2024-05-23. Employer approves leave in p25; ZUS award and payment unconfirmed. Date mismatch requires further reconciliation.
full_source_audit.note: Do not confuse an application or a contribution wage with approved payment.
